subject: Intro call recap & path to sign — NovaRetail discovery
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@novaretail.com>, Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@novaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Intro call recap & path to sign — NovaRetail discovery

Amy / Mark — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap from our call so we have a shared view and a lightweight path-to-sign. I captured pain, success metrics, owners and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached) to move from pilot → contract.

Key pain points you described
- Latency spikes impacting checkout personalization (95th pctile > 600ms during peak).
- Token cost ballooning on existing embeddings pipeline; need predictable unit economics.
- Data residency and auditability requirements for payment-related PII.

Goals we aligned on
1) Pilot to validate 95th pctile latency <= 200ms for 0.5–1k rps profile
2) Embedding cost reduction of ~40% vs current baseline (without loss of retrieval quality)
3) Security posture: SOC2 evidence, VPC option for payments data, and key rotation policy

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — also attached as scoping-mpa-draft.pdf
- Milestone A (Pilot readiness): engineering kickoff, sample data ingestion, perf baseline — Target: 2027-01-14 — Owner: Hannah (Redwood) / Amy (NovaRetail)
- Milestone B (Pilot run): 2-week run with traffic mirror, perf/cost telemetry, anomaly review — Target: 2027-02-01 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Mark (NovaRetail)
- Milestone C (Commercial decision): review pilot results, legal & security signoff, PO/contract — Target: 2027-02-18 — Owner: Ben (Redwood Sales) / TBD (NovaRetail Procurement)

Immediate next steps (this week)
- You to share the procurement contact and any internal PO timeline (Amy).
- We will share a 1-page pilot scope and test plan (attached) and a high-level pricing range for pilot capacity by EOD Friday.
- Schedule a 30m follow-up with your engineering + CISO (proposed Wednesday 12/29 — please confirm).

Notes on redlines/security: Our Private deployment (VPC + KMS) covers the data residency ask — we can start evidence transfer for SOC2 items once your CISO confirms the scope. See the security FAQ at the end of the attached MPA.

Attachments: scoping-mpa-draft.pdf (MPA with milestones and owners), quick-pilot-scope.txt

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the proposed slot once you confirm availability.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
redwoodinference.com
From: Amy Chen <amy@novaretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@novaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro call recap & path to sign — NovaRetail discovery

Hannah — thanks for the clear summary. That matches our notes. A few quick clarifications from my side:

- Procurement: I’ll introduce you to our procurement lead (Lynn Park) and our legal contact (contracts@novaretail.com). We have a standard SOW/PO cadence — we usually need ~2–3 weeks once security is satisfied.
- CISO: Our CISO (Raj Patel) will want a quick SOC2 + network diagram review. Can your security team send the SOC2 scope and an example network diagram (VPC peering) to raj@novaretail.com?
- Pricing: we’re comfortable with a pilot with a cost-transparent structure (monthly cap preferred). Can you confirm a headline pilot price band for the proposed capacity (1k rps mirror, embeddings, and 500k tokens/day) before Friday?

We’re good to try the 12/29 time block for the engineering + CISO sync — please send details. Also note: we are on a year-end freeze until 12/27; any approvals will start after that date.

Best,
Amy
VP, Product — NovaRetail
Amy Chen | amy@novaretail.com | +1 312-555-0144
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@novaretail.com>, Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@novaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call recap & path to sign — NovaRetail discovery

Thanks Amy — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers and an updated MPA note inline: 

1) Security materials: attaching a SOC2 snapshot and a simple VPC diagram (see attachment in the MPA PDF). I’ll copy Raj on the 12/29 invite and follow up to pull anything else your CISO asks for.
2) Pricing band for pilot (headline): USD 18k–24k/month (covers reserved inference units for the test profile, streaming RD, and basic telemetry). We’ll provide a more granular breakdown in the one-pager we promised. If you prefer a hard monthly cap, we can lock a $24k cap for the pilot period.
3) Procurement intro: please loop Lynn and contracts@novaretail.com. To help speed procurement we can provide a short SOW + plug-in clause for VPC & KMS.

Updated Milestones & Dates (finalized for calendar planning):
- Engineering kickoff & data transfer (Target: 2027-01-12) — Owners: Hannah / Amy
- Pilot run (Target window: 2027-01-25 → 2027-02-08) — Owners: Marissa / Mark
- Final results + exec review (Target: 2027-02-11) — Owners: Ben / Amy
- Contract signature (Target: 2027-02-25) — Owners: Ben / Lynn Park (Procurement)

I’ve attached the scoping MPA (scoping-mpa-draft.pdf) with these updated dates and a short success-metrics table. Sending the 12/29 10:30am ET invite to the list now.

On the legal side, Ben (cc) will handle the commercial negotiation and any potential credit/commitments. If procurement needs a capacity commitment to get internal budget cleared, we can discuss a small reserved commitment for the first 90 days.

—
Hannah
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Intro call recap & path to sign — NovaRetail discovery (internal)

Hannah — reading the MPA I think there’s a reasonable chance NovaRetail will request a small commercial concession to get procurement to sign off quickly (standard). I recommend we pre-authorize up to 10% pilot-cap concession if needed; I’ve drafted a quick redline for the SOW (redlines_v1.pdf).

Actions for us: 
- Marissa: please prep the pilot runbook and telemetry dashboards so we can show concrete observability in the kickoff.
- Hannah: I’ll coordinate with legal on the SOW redline and aim to get a suggested concession approved by EOD Friday (12/31).

Note: keep the monthly cap option in the offer ($24k) — it reduces procurement friction.

—Ben
Senior Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Amy Chen <amy@novaretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@novaretail.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@novaretail.com>, Lynn Park <lynn.park@novaretail.com>, contracts@novaretail.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 08:46:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro call recap & path to sign — NovaRetail discovery

Hannah / Ben — thanks for the follow-ups and the MPA. 12/29 works for us — Raj will join for the security portion. A couple final asks before the kickoff:

1) Please send the SOC2 scope and VPC diagram to raj@novaretail.com (we need to validate network controls before we mirror traffic).
2) Can you include a short appendix in the SOW that documents data flows for payment-related requests? Our compliance team will want that for the procurement package.
3) Timeline note: because of our internal freeze, procurement will only start pushing approvals on 12/27 — so the best-case contract path lands in mid-February as you outlined.

We’re excited to run the pilot. See you on Wednesday.

Best,
Amy
